description: This file defines a Java interface named Histogram for measuring the statistical distribution of values in a data stream. It extends other metric-related interfaces and provides methods for recording values and retrieving recorded data.

classes.name: Histogram
classes.description: An interface for histogram metrics that allows recording values and retrieving recorded data.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a specific value in the histogram.

methods.name: getRecordedValues
methods.description: Returns all values that have been recorded in the histogram.
